posts.title: Re:ZERO - Starting Life in Another World - Season 5 Production Confirmed
posts.description: With over 16 million copies of the original light novel series in circulation worldwide, including digital editions, Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- celebrates the 10th anniversary of its TV anime adaptation in 2026. Today, during the 10th anniversary event, Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- 10th EVENT -Starlight Party-, held at TACHIKAWA STAGE GARDEN, it was announced that Season 5 of the TV anime is officially in production. An ultra teaser visual hinting at the story to come has also been revealed. Featuring the tagline, “For you, again and again.”, the visual depicts Natsuki Subaru and Rem setting out on a new adventure together. To commemorate the announcement of the new season, a special congratulatory message has also arrived from original author Tappei Nagatsuki. Please continue to look forward to what’s next for Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-. posts.title: Megan Oliver Interview - Hate and Other Acts of Fiction
posts.description: Photo Credit: © Danika Corrall Megan Oliver is a writer, an avid romance reader, and a travel enthusiast whose vacation mishaps provide plenty of inspiration for her characters on page. She lives with her husband, two dogs who refuse to cuddle as much as she’d prefer, and a cat who barely tolerates the presence of any and all above. Secret Nights and Northern Lights is her debut novel. When/how did you realize you had a creative dream or calling to fulfill? I had always been an avid reader my entire life, but in 2019 I suddenly had the idea to try and write a book. I thought it would just be for fun and something I probably wouldn’t even finish. But I did finish it, and I fell in love with writing along the way. Nothing happened with that first book as far as publishing goes, but the process taught me that I could write a full-length novel and set me on the path to where I am today. posts.title: Kennedy Cole Interview - There Used to Be People Here
posts.description: Photo Content from Kennedy Cole Kennedy Cole is a speculative author born and raised in North Carolina. Her creative portfolio includes internships with Blair Publisher, ONLY POEMS, Lookout Books, and History Through Fiction, as well as an array of published poetry, fiction, and nonfiction. Her debut horror novel, THERE USED TO BE PEOPLE HERE, will be published with Berkley at Penguin Random House in November 2026. A graduate of UNC Wilmington, Kennedy lives by the beach with her partner and enjoys playing games, puzzling, sipping matcha, and collecting tattoos. Ask her about her favorite movies, recent meals she’s cheffed up, or whatever video game she’s fixated on. She’ll have plenty to say. Beyond your own work (of course), what is your all-time favorite book and why? And what is your favorite book outside of your genre? Piranesi by Susanna Clarke!!
